subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Should Feishu treat `oc_...` events reported as `chat_type: "p2p"` as group/topic conversations, and should the discriminator be chat-id prefix based, thread/root-id based, or resolved through Feishu chat metadata?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent discriminator affects direct/group routing, session identity, topic delivery, and policy boundaries, and current related PRs intentionally differ on how broadly to promote bare `oc_...` targets.

options.title: Adopt a narrow OpenChat discriminator
options.body: Treat `oc_...` p2p inbound events as group/topic only in Feishu-owned routing helpers, keep ambiguous bare outbound targets direct unless existing context proves group identity, and add targeted regressions.

options.title: Require metadata lookup before promotion
options.body: Resolve ambiguous Feishu chat ids through Feishu chat metadata before changing route type, accepting extra lookup and fallback complexity for stronger classification proof.

options.title: Leave p2p strict until live proof exists
options.body: Keep current direct-message behavior and require a live Feishu proof PR before changing session routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow OpenChat discriminator
recommendation.body: Treat `oc_...` p2p inbound events as group/topic only in Feishu-owned routing helpers, keep ambiguous bare outbound targets direct unless existing context proves group identity, and add targeted regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged Feishu chat-type resolver work is the closest current-main precedent for resolving ambiguous direct/group Feishu routing safely.
